title: The Old Wars: The First

texts.details:
Your trainer sent you for the First War. Then sit, because it is not a short tale and it is not a proud one.

A door was opened in the swamp to the east. A mad sorcerer of ours and a warlock of theirs made it between them. The orcs came through it full of a demon's blood and wanting nothing but to kill. Their warchief Blackhand sent raiders into these very hills, and into Westfall, and village after village simply ceased to be.

We lost, $N. The King was murdered in his own keep by an assassin he trusted. Stormwind was burned to the ground. Lord Lothar put what was left of us on ships and sailed north to beg.

There are Blackrock in my hills today who have never stopped fighting that war. Take six of their grunts, in the hills east of the lake. Their leader is Gormash. Kill him.
texts.objectives: Kill 6 Blackrock Grunts and then Gormash the Unbowed, in the hills east of Lake Everstill. Return to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
texts.progress: They fight as they did then: all forward, no thought of tomorrow.
texts.completion:
Gormash is dead. One less who thinks it is still that year.

Here is what the First War teaches, and I learned it running. Rage wins the charge and loses the war. They beat us because we were proud and stood alone; no other kingdom would stir for Stormwind until it was ash. And they could not hold what they took, because all they had was fury, and fury burns down.

Keep yours, $N. Do not let it pour out of you the moment the fighting stops. A warrior who can carry his anger from one fight to the next has the best of both peoples. You will find you can do that now.

For the Second War, go to Southshore, in Hillsbrad, when you have thirty seasons. Ask for Marshal Redpath.

idea: The Old Wars, level 20 (Alliance): the First War. From the wiki: Medivh and Gul'dan opened the Dark Portal; the orcs came with demonic bloodlust; Blackhand sent raiding parties into Brightwood, Westfall and Redridge and their villages fell; Garona killed King Llane; Stormwind was razed; Lothar led the survivors by sea to Lordaeron; other nations saw Stormwind's isolation as arrogance. Gives the perk of rage that drains slower. Invented: Gormash the Unbowed.
